items.title: Consumer Stocks Are Big Losers After Latest Earnings Wave
items.summary: Consumer stocks were taking a beating after the latest round of retail earnings.  The consumer staples sector was the biggest laggard in the S&P 500 with a 1.9% decline.  Among the biggest S&P 500 losers of the day were Walmart, Ford Motor, Norwegian Cruise Line Holdings, lululemon athletica, and Auto Zone.
